name: SpecWM: Turning Verification into Refinement for Streaming World Models
title: SpecWM: Turning Verification into Refinement for Streaming World Models
summary: SpecWM is a training-free inference framework for streaming video world models that verifies draft chunks using the target model's latent velocity field and applies reusable corrections via threshold-based accept/refine/reject decisions to improve visual quality, control, and speed.
